scope: Small real-video diversity corpus for decoder/Apple-Vision/tracking robustness. Count expectations exist only where explicitly reviewed. This is not a population accuracy benchmark or form-validity dataset.

cases.review_scope: Existing fully reviewed 40-frame fixture and one-movement regression in source.json.

visual_review.method: Existing source.json review plus generated corpus contact sheet.
visual_review.observed_content: One athlete, fixed landscape rear/oblique camera, standard pull-up apparatus and one reviewed movement cycle.
limitations: Head/chin crop prevents strict top-form grading.

cases.review_scope: Previously reviewed 0-4 second interval: two people introducing the exercise, zero pull-ups.

visual_review.method: Reviewed generated derivative/contact sheet; this is the previously rejected 0-4 s smoke interval.
visual_review.observed_content: Two people stand in front of the pull-up station introducing the exercise; zero pull-up cycles.
limitations: Stress case for additional people/background, not a movement-count fixture.

visual_review.method: All 48 prepared frames re-inspected in indexed temporal order at 8 FPS; the initial broad contact sheet had obscured that frame 0 begins mid-attempt.
visual_review.observed_content: One athlete, fixed rear/oblique indoor-gym view, standard straight pull-up bar. The clip begins mid-ascent, descends to full extension, then contains one countable extension-to-top pull-up movement.
limitations: Leading mid-attempt motion must not be counted because the clip does not show its extended start.
On-screen PULL-UPS title partially covers the lower-right image but does not cover the selected arm/bar.
Movement-only ground truth; no chin-clearance or form-validity label.

count_expectation.bar_reference_note: Manually reviewed visible bar centerline in the 640x360 prepared image; fixed camera, reused for all frames.

cases.license: Public domain in the United States (official U.S. Air Force work)
cases.credit: U.S. Air Force video by Staff Sgt. James Kennedy

visual_review.method: Temporary full-source review artifact was inspected first; all 20 frames of the selected 23.625-26.125 s derivative were then reviewed at 8 FPS before Apple Vision corpus inference.
visual_review.observed_content: A real pull-up in a crowded indoor gym. A foreground observer substantially occludes the athlete while additional people and equipment remain visible in the background.
limitations: Stress/coverage only; no rep-count or form label.
Scene-level person/arm coverage does not establish athlete identity continuity.
At least one real-Vision multi-person frame is required so production's explicit multi-person rejection path is exercised instead of silently selecting a person.

visual_review.method: All 96 prepared frames were inspected in indexed temporal order at 8 FPS before Apple Vision corpus inference.
visual_review.observed_content: One athlete performs real bodyweight dips on two fixed parallel rails in a portrait side/oblique outdoor-gym view. Prepared frame 0 is already at the bent/low endpoint and the athlete first rises to extension; after that leading partial return, five complete extension-to-bent-to-extension movement cycles are visible.
limitations: The leading bent-to-extension partial motion is not a countable cycle because its extended start is outside the clip.
Movement-cycle ground truth only; dip depth, lockout validity, body alignment and overall form are not qualified.
The image-plane elbow angle is an engineering signal, not a calibrated anatomical 3D angle.

count_expectation.bar_reference_note: Manually reviewed fixed near-side rail centerline immediately to the right of the selected hand in the 360x640 prepared image; fixed camera, reused for all frames.

visual_review.method: Generated 2-second contact sheet inspected before Apple Vision corpus inference.
visual_review.observed_content: Single athlete outdoors in portrait framing performing highly nonstandard one-arm hanging/pull movement with large swing/inversion and changing body orientation.
limitations: Stress/coverage only; no rep-count or form label.
Motion blur/defocus appears near the end.

visual_review.method: Generated 2-second contact sheet inspected before Apple Vision corpus inference.
visual_review.observed_content: Single athlete outdoors using a tree branch as nonstandard apparatus, with substantial swing/inversion and foliage/high-contrast background.
limitations: Stress/coverage only; no rep-count or form label.
Tree/foliage can occlude limbs near the top of motion.

known_gap.status: Real parallel-bar dip footage is now pinned and movement-count-qualified. Dip-depth/form validity, 3D joint accuracy and held-out population-level accuracy remain unqualified.

review_policy: Visual expectations were recorded before corpus inference. The FitnessScape count label was later corrected from 2 to 1 after indexed-frame visual re-review showed frame 0 already mid-ascent; the counter output was not used to redefine endpoint thresholds. The Yokota crowded-pull-up interval and its multi-person requirement were committed from visual review before running Apple Vision on that interval. The JULLIAN W dip fixture was reviewed over all 96 prepared frames and labelled as five complete extension-to-bent-to-extension cycles, after one leading partial return, before Apple Vision was run on it.
